An important set of vocal exercises to build vocal

correctItems.text: This kriti has an additional portion in madhayama kala, which is sung twice as fast as the rest of the composition.
In this raga, the notes - gandhar, dhaivat and nishad - are komal, and the remaining notes are shudh.
Its vaadi note is 'dhaivat' and the samvaadi note is 'gandhar'.
The 'gandhar' and 'nishad' are missing notes in aroh (ascending order), due to which the jathi of this raga is audav-sampoorna.
